Sincerely,

```{r, results="asis"}
corr <- Filter(function(a) isTRUE(a$corresponding), meta$authors)[[1]]
p <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$name_en, corr$name_en), c(list(cv$pi), cv$co_pi))[[1]]
cat(corr$name_en, ", ", corr$degrees, "  \n", corr$designation, ", ", corr$affiliation, "  \n", corr$address, "  \n",
    "E-mail: ", p$email, "; Telephone: ", p$phone_en %||% p$phone, "  \n", "On behalf of all authors\n", sep = "")
```
